name: pii-browser
description: Browser-first PII detection, obfuscation, and de-obfuscation with a precompiled Rust/WASM core and GLiNER integration.

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p ./vendor && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" wasm-pack build ../../rust/pii-wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/pii-browser/vendor/pii-wasm --out-name pii_wasm && node ../../scripts/finalize-wasm-pkg.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm run build:wasm && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm run prepare:runtime && pnpm run build:wasm && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.publish:public: pnpm run build && npm publish --access public
